snippet.title: Balatro - Friends of Jimbo | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You can't spell "collaboration" without "Balatro"

Add some visual flair to your decks with these new cosmetic card skins inspired by fan-favorite characters from The Witcher 3, Dave the Diver, Vampire Survivors, and Among Us. This update is now available free of charge on PC & Consoles

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/
Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/balatro-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010334
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/balatro/9PK087LNGJC5
